verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              दामोदरवचः श्रुत्वा हृष्टास्ते गोषु जीविनः। तद्वागमृतमासाद्य प्रत्यूचुरविशङ्कया॥१॥
तवैषा बाल महती गोपाणां हितवर्धिनी। प्रीणयत्येव नः सर्वान्बुद्धिर्वृद्धिकरी गवाम्॥२॥
verses.bhavadeepa: अथ सप्तदशेऽध्याये गोवर्धन महोत्सवः। वर्ण्यते हरिणा क्लृप्तो दर्शनं तस्य चाद्भुतम्॥१॥ अविशङ्कया इन्द्रात् भयम् अशङ्कमाना इत्यर्थः॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: त्वं गतिस्त्वं रतिश्चैव त्वं वेत्ता त्वं परायणम्। भयेष्वभयदस्त्वं नस्त्वमेव सुहृदां सुहृत्॥३॥
verses.english: By the grace of my father I acquired longevity, and owing to my devoutness to my father I also acquired high renown in this mortal world...

verses.sanskrit: त्वत्कृते कृष्ण घोषोऽयं क्षेमी मुदितगोकुलः। कृत्स्नो वसति शान्तारिर्यथा स्वर्गं गतस्तथा॥४॥
verses.english: Such as I am I undertook very difficult ascesis on Mt. meru for some thousands of years a the close of युग, era...

verses.sanskrit: जन्मप्रभृति कर्मैतद्देवैरसुकरं भुवि। बोद्धव्याच्चाभिमानाच्च विस्मितानि मनांसि नः॥५॥
verses.english: You are undertaking ascesis just to jhave a glimpse at me... here I present myeslf to you... now, tell me what I can do for you..." Thus सनत्कुमर said toi sage mArkanDeya.

verses.sanskrit: बलेन च परार्ध्येन यशसा विक्रमेणा च। उत्तमस्त्वं मनुष्येषु देवेष्विव पुरन्दरः॥६॥
verses.english: At certain certain time during that period I saw an aircraft coming from north brightening the sky with its resplendence...
verses.bhavadeepa: एतच्छकटभङ्गादि कर्म दृष्ट्वेति शेषः। बोद्धव्यात् द्रष्टुं योग्यात्तत्वाभिमानादहङ्कारादहं कारयिष्यामि गोयज्ञं बलादेतन्न संशय इत्येवंरूपात्। एकश्चकारः पादपूरणार्थः॥५॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रतापेन च तीक्ष्णेन दीप्त्या पुर्णतयापि च। उत्तमस्त्वं च मर्त्येषु देवेष्विव दिवाकरः॥७॥
verses.english: I still retain the aura of a neonate with which I took birth; hence I am called कुमर... a boy; सनत् - always; कुमर - a boy; a perpetual neonate; because neonates are doubtlessly away from lust, greed, conceit etc., so am I... so my name too came to pass as सनत्-कुमर...

verses.sanskrit: कान्त्या लक्ष्म्या प्रसादेन वदनेन स्मितेन च। उत्तमस्त्वं च मर्त्येषु देवेष्विव निशाकरः॥८॥
verses.english: Then, on revering that emplaned being with folded-palms and bowing down and offering holy water, I asked, "you appear to be undeniable, aggregate of ascesis and prowess, possessing a triumphant air of nArAyaNa about you... to me you look like god of gods... but, how do I signify you...

verses.sanskrit: बलेन वपुषा चैव बाल्येन चरितेन च। स्यात्ते शक्तिधरस्तुल्यो न तु कश्चन मानुषः॥९॥
verses.english: Then that highsouled-being spoke to me smilingly, "unconsummated is your ascesis wherefore you are unable to recognise me..." and then in a trice he transfigured into a most astonishing form... I have never seen such a personality in any man till then...

verses.sanskrit: यत्त्वयाभिहितं वाक्यं गिरियज्ञं प्रति प्रभो। कस्तल्लङ्घयितुं शक्तो वेलामिव महोदधिः॥१०॥
verses.english: "Know me as the eldest brainchild of brahma... you are right in saying that I am an 'aggregate of ascesis and prowess, possessing an air of nArAyaNa about me' etc... I am that सनत्कुमार... you might have heard about me from the legendarily accounts of gods... blest you be... what can I do for you...

verses.sanskrit: स्थितः शक्रमहस्तात श्रीमान्गिरिमहस्त्वयम्। त्वत्प्रणीतोऽद्य गोपानां गवां हेतोः प्रवर्त्यताम्॥११॥
verses.english: The other brainchildren of brahma younger to me are: क्रतु, वसिष्ठ, पुलह, पुलस्त्य, अत्रि, अङ्गिर, and मरिअचि. The lineages of these insuperable brainchildren of brahma are well established, and they who are reverential equally to gods and gandharva-s will hold the three worlds together, after receiving worship from those gods and gandharva-s...

verses.sanskrit: भोजनान्युपकल्प्यन्तां पयसः पेशलानि च। कुम्भाश्च विनिवेश्यन्तामुदपानेषु शोभनाः॥१२॥
verses.english: Amalgamating our souls in supreme soul, we the brainchildren of brahma discarded libidinal activity thus remained non-procreative...

verses.sanskrit: पूर्यन्तां पयसा नद्यो द्रोण्यश्च विपुलायताः। भक्ष्यं भोज्यं च पेयं च तत्सर्वमुपनीयताम्॥१३॥
verses.english: Amalgamating our souls in supreme soul, we the brainchildren of brahma discarded libidinal activity thus remained non-procreative...

verses.sanskrit: भाजनानि च मांसस्य न्यस्यन्तामोदनस्य च। त्रिरात्रं चैव सन्दोहः सर्वघोषस्य गृह्यताम्॥१४॥
verses.english: You are undertaking ascesis just to jhave a glimpse at me... here I present myeslf to you... now, tell me what I can do for you..." Thus सनत्कुमर said toi sage mArkanDeya.

verses.sanskrit: विशस्यन्तां च पशवो भोज्या ये महिषादयः। प्रवर्त्यतां च यज्ञोऽयं सर्वगोपसुसङ्कुलः॥१५॥
verses.english: When that sempiternal god sanatkumara spoke to me in this way, then I asked that acquiescent god, of course, taking his permission to receive questions, about the genesis of manes, results of their beatification etc...
verses.bhavadeepa: सन्दोहः पयआदिः गृह्यतां न तु विक्रेयः॥१४॥

verses.sanskrit: आनन्दजननो घोषो महान्मुदितगोकुलः। तूर्यप्रणादघोषैश्च वृषभाणां च गर्जितैः॥१६॥
verses.english: Each to each is a father as well as a son in give and take relationship... thus the words देवताः and पितराः - gods and manes, can become nomenclative in their proper sense... therefore, you gods, you should be familiar with this interrelationship...

verses.sanskrit: हम्भारवैश्च वत्सानां गोपानां हर्षवर्धनः। दध्नो ह्रदो घृतावर्तः पयः कुल्यासमाकुलः॥१७॥
verses.english: Originally brahma created gods saying to them, "you needs must adore me..." But, those gods left him off and started adoring themselves, as the beneficiaries of fruits of actions done by humans and other living beings... then brahma had to curse them saying, "you fools you shall now become scatterbrained loosing the faculty of retention..." Then they not only became blockheaded but also checked out of heaven because they are unable to recollect what heaven meant to them...

verses.sanskrit: मांसराशिः प्रभूताढ्यः प्रकाशौदनपर्वतः। सम्प्रावर्तत यज्ञोऽस्य गिरेर्गोभिः समाकुलः॥१८॥
verses.english: Later the gods reverently pleaded for the mercy of brahma, and brahma benevolently accorded it saying, "you gods, you will have to atone yourselves for your deviating behaviour... now go and seek your own sons, from whom you will receive proper enlightenment...
verses.bhavadeepa: दध्नो हृदः घृतावर्तः साररूपेण घृतं यत्रोपर्यावर्तते स तथा॥१७॥

verses.sanskrit: तुष्टगोपजनाकीर्णो गोपनारीमनोहरः। भक्ष्याणां राशयस्तत्र शतशश्चोपकल्पिताः। गन्धमाल्यैश्च विविधैर्धूपैरुच्चावचैस्तथा॥१९॥
verses.english: Like distracted beings then the gods approached their own sons seeking information as to how to make amends. Their sons enlightened them about the propitiatory acts of atonement for the wrongdoings, done at three levels viz. mentally, vocally or physically, that mainly concerns about the filial duteousness... at the end, the sons of gods said to their fathers, "you have learned enough, म्य् देअर् सोन्स्, now you may return to brahma, the only knower of the subtext of atonement..."

verses.sanskrit: अथाधिशृतपर्यन्ते सम्प्राप्ते यज्ञसंविधौ। यज्ञं गिरेस्तिथौ सौम्ये चक्रुर्गोपा द्विजैः सह॥२०॥
verses.english: Those gods are already carrying a curse of brahma on their head... now they felt ridiculed when their sons expressed a 'reverse filiation'... then the gods again approached brahma seeking clarification on this...

verses.sanskrit: यजनान्ते तदन्नं तु तत्पयो दधि चोत्तमम्। मांसं च मायया कृष्णो गिरिर्भूत्वा समश्नुते॥२१॥
verses.english: Dispelling all my doubts, oh, bhIShma... he told me at the end of his long-time narration, "oh, brahma-sage mArkanDeya, I am pleased with you... you may now listen to all in detail...
verses.bhavadeepa: अधिशृतानि वह्निस्थानि चरुस्थाल्यादीनि पर्यन्तानि समीपे आसादितानि यस्मिन्॥२०॥

verses.sanskrit: तर्पिताश्चापि विप्राग्र्यास्तुष्टाः सम्पूर्णमानसाः। उत्तस्थुः प्रीतमनसः स्वस्ति वाच्यं यथासुखम्॥२२॥
verses.english: Each to each is a father as well as a son in give and take relationship... thus the words देवताः and पितराः - gods and manes, can become nomenclative in their proper sense... therefore, you gods, you should be familiar with this interrelationship...

verses.sanskrit: भुक्त्वा चावभृते कृष्णः पयः पीत्वा च कामतः। सन्तृप्तोऽस्मीति दिव्येन रूपेण प्रजहास वै॥२३॥
verses.english: Then the gods came back to their sons and said to them, "brahma dispelled all our doubts and we glad to know each other... oh, sons of gods, whatever you said is nothing but truth... you achieved fatherhood because you termed us as your sons... no doubt about it... oh, sons of gods, because you imparted knowledge to us you have become our fathers of gnosis - ज्ञन पित-स्... not only to us gods, but you should have fatherhood of all worlds... you are gods because you the sons of gods, and now on achieving fatherhood you shall be called पितॄ देवता-s... fatherly-gods... so-called manes... tell us what boon can be given to you... what for your heart is longing and..." Thus gods asked their sons. But when the sons of gods maintained a reticent silence, the gods continued to say:

verses.sanskrit: तं गोपाः पर्वताकारं दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनम्। गिरिमूर्ध्नि स्थितं दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं जग्मुः प्रधानतः॥२४॥
verses.english: Those gods are already carrying a curse of brahma on their head... now they felt ridiculed when their sons expressed a 'reverse filiation'... then the gods again approached brahma seeking clarification on this...

verses.sanskrit: भगवानपि तेनैव रूपेणाच्छादितः प्रभुः। सहितैः प्रणतो गोपैर्ववन्दात्मानमात्मना॥२५॥
verses.english: And when, oh, sons of gods, who now stand consecrated as पितृ-गणा-s, observances of fatherly gods, so-called manes, you will be sated with the beatification processes offered to you, you in turn will always be satiating सोम, the god of moon and the repository of nectar, and when सोम is sated through you, he will be sating whole world spanning from mountains to oceans, whether animate or inanimate... this shall be the cyclic process in give-and-take syndrome...

verses.sanskrit: तमूचुर्विस्मिता गोपा देवं गिरिवरे स्थितम्। भगवंस्त्वद्वशे युक्ता दासाः किं कुर्म किङ्कराः॥२६॥
verses.english: Thus this beatification is welfare-enriching process to those humans who undertake it, and you as fatherly-gods shall always be according well-being, progeny etc to them...

verses.sanskrit: स उवाच ततो गोपान्गिरिप्रभवया गिरा। अद्यप्रभृति चेज्योऽहं गोषु यद्यस्तु वो दया॥२७॥
verses.english: Thus this beatification is welfare-enriching process to those humans who undertake it, and you as fatherly-gods shall always be according well-being, progeny etc to them...

verses.sanskrit: अहं वः प्रथमो देवः सर्वकामकरः शुभः। मम प्रभावाच्च गवामयुतान्येव भोक्ष्यथ॥२८॥
verses.english: This is how the supreme brahma educated us... as such, oh, sons of gods, his word shall come true... henceforth let us mutually become fathers and/or sons according as the situation..." This is how gods who realised their mistake have said to their sons.

verses.sanskrit: शिवश्च वो भविष्यामि मद्भक्तानां वने वने। रंस्ये च सह युष्माभिर्यथा दिविगतस्तथा॥२९॥
verses.english: "Thus the gods are both fathers and gods; fatherly gods are both fathers and gods; they mutually conduct themselves in पिता-पुत्र-न्याय - an indivisible syndrome of father-son-father-son, ad infinitum..."Thus sanat-kumAra enlightened sage mArkanDeya about the genesis of fatherly-gods, so-called manes, and about the fruits of their beatification.

verses.sanskrit: ये चेमे प्रथिता गोपा नन्दगोपपुरोगमाः। एषां प्रीतः प्रयच्छामि गोपानां विपुलं धनम्॥३०॥
पर्याप्नुवन्तु क्षिप्रं मां गावो वत्ससमाकुलाः। एवं मम परा प्रीतिर्भविष्यति न संशयः॥३१॥
verses.english: Thus, this is the seventeenth chapter of first canto called harivamsha-parva, in harivamsha-purANa, the sequel of mahAbhArata, narrating the genesis of fatherly-gods, so-called manes, and about the fruits of their beatification.

verses.sanskrit: ततो नीराजनार्थं हि वृन्दशो गोकुलाणि तम्। परिवव्रुर्गिरिवरं सवृषाणि समन्ततः॥३२॥
verses.english: "Thus the gods are both fathers and gods; fatherly gods are both fathers and gods; they mutually conduct themselves in पिता-पुत्र-न्याय - an indivisible syndrome of father-son-father-son, ad infinitum..."Thus sanat-kumAra enlightened sage mArkanDeya about the genesis of fatherly-gods, so-called manes, and about the fruits of their beatification.

verses.sanskrit: ता गावः प्रद्रुता हृष्टाः सापीडस्तबकाङ्गदाः। सस्रजापीडशृङ्गाग्राः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥३३॥
अनुजग्मुश्च गोपालाः कालयन्तो धनानि च। भक्तिच्छेदानुलिप्ताङ्गा रक्तपीतसिताम्बराः॥३४॥
verses.bhavadeepa: सापीडाः सशिरोभूषणाः ताश्च ताः स्तबकाङ्गदाः पुष्पगुच्छाकाराणि बाहुभूषणानि यासां ताः। स्रजश्च आपीडाः शृङ्गारभूषणानि तैश्च सहितानि सस्रजापीडानि शृङ्गाग्राणि यासां ताः॥३३॥

verses.sanskrit: मयूरचित्राङ्गदिनो भुजैः प्रहरणावृतैः। मयूरपत्रवृन्तानां केशबन्धैः सुयोजितैः॥३५॥
verses.bhavadeepa: कालयन्तो नियमयन्तः धनानि गोधनानि भक्तिच्छेदैर्विभागभेदैः अनुलिप्ताङ्गाः नानावर्णैरनुलेपितानि पृथक् पृथगङ्गानि यैस्तादृशा इत्यर्थः॥३४॥

verses.sanskrit: बभ्राजुरधिकं गोपाः समवाये तदाद्भुते। अन्ये वृषानारुरुहुर्नृत्यन्ति स्म परे मुदा॥३६॥
verses.english: Whoso worships gods and gods alone, duly bypassing the acts of beatifying fatherly-gods viz. the श्राद्ध-क्रिया-s to pitR^i devatA-s, so-called manes; the fruits of his worship are henceforth transferable to राक्षसा-स्, दानवा-स् and नागा-स्...
verses.bhavadeepa: प्रहरणावृतैः सायुधैः मयूरपत्राणां वृन्तानि मध्यशङ्कवः तेषाम्॥३५॥

verses.sanskrit: गोपालास्त्वपरे गाश्च जगृहुर्वेगगामिनः। तस्मिन्पर्यायनिर्वृत्ते गवां नीराजनोत्सवे॥३७॥
अन्तर्धानं जगामाशु तेन देहेन सोऽचलः। कृष्णोऽपि गोपसहितो विवेश व्रजमेव ह॥३८॥
गिरियज्ञप्रवृत्तेन तेनाश्चर्येण विस्मिताः। गोपाः सबालवृद्धा वै तुष्टुवुर्मधुसूदनम्॥३९॥
